description: June 30 birthday meaning: Cancer decan 1, birthday number 3, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a June 30 birthday falls in Cancer, in the first decan, with Moon as the sign's ruler and Moon as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 3. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Cancer is cardinal and water.

sections.heading: June 30 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: June ends with Cancer eight degrees along and the expressive number 3. The Moon's decan gives emotional depth; three gives that depth a voice. This birthday is often linked with warm humour, family anecdotes and a talent for making people feel included. Traditional readings note a tendency to hide hurt behind jokes, so honest conversations tend to help.

On June 30 the Sun usually sits at about 8° Cancer, in the first decan, where Moon rules the decan as well as the sign. The Moon rules Cancer and also presides over its first decan, so roughly June 22 to July 1 is traditionally the most lunar part of the year. Feeling comes first here, often before words. Natives of this decan are frequently portrayed as protective, intuitive and deeply attached to home, family and memory. Their moods may rise and fall like tides, which is less a flaw than a rhythm worth learning. A doubled Moon can also mean holding on to old hurts longer than they deserve. Giving care to themselves as freely as they give it to everyone else is often the central lesson.

sections.heading: June 30 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 30th reduces as 3 + 0 = 3. The 0 is often read as amplifying the 3, so this birthday number carries an extra dose of expression, imagination and social energy. Unlike the 12th or 21st, the compound contains only the 3 itself, which numerologists sometimes describe as creativity without dilution. Thirtieth-born people are frequently described as eloquent, entertaining and quick with ideas. As a secondary number, the 30 tends to shine in writing, speaking or performance. Focus is their usual challenge, since so many ideas compete for attention.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one June 30 birthday to the next: it is 7 for 1960, 8 for 1970, 9 for 1980 and 1 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on June 30: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: A June birthday falls at the height of northern summer, around the longest days of the year, while in the southern hemisphere it marks the darkest stretch near the winter solstice. Gemini covers most of the month, with Cancer beginning around June 21. June is month 6 in numerology, a number of care, responsibility and home, which foreshadows the Cancerian turn at the month's end. June 30 is the 181st day of the year (182nd in a leap year). By July 23, 23 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Leo.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by June 30, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on June 30 include Mike Tyson (1966), Michael Phelps (1985) and Serzh Sargsyan (1954).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is June 30?
faq.answer: June 30 is Cancer in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Cancer, which tradition links with Moon.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on June 30?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On June 30 the Life Path is 7 in 1960, 8 in 1970, 9 in 1980, 1 in 1990, 11 in 2000, 3 in 2010 and 4 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 3 for everyone born on the 30th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on June 30?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a June 30 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on June 30?
faq.answer: June 30 is also the birthday of Mike Tyson (1966), Michael Phelps (1985) and Serzh Sargsyan (1954). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
